name: Look at a pose
objective: Reads a pose kept in the pose bridge (a scene saved from the 3D OpenPose editor, or one an AI made) and says what it is: each joint's position (centimetres; y up from the floor, x to the viewer's right, z toward the viewer) and each bone's direction and each elbow's and knee's bend in words. Use it to see what a person changed before changing it further (Make a pose with this file as its base).

poser.about: the pose bridge the pose is kept in

pose.label: Which pose
pose.hint: A file name, or latest: the one changed last (what a person just saved).
